notes.title: Next Fest Update
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

It's taken a good amount of time, but a new update is here. There are a lot of changes which ultimately take the game in a new and better direction while maintaining the original themes:


     Camera Mechanic: you will now have a camera you can use to picture and document the environment with. It may even reveal hidden clues or messages, and deter dangers ...
     Swimming: water no longer "kills" or resets your progress. You can swim in the water, but it is not fun to do so - still acting as a punishment for failed jumps.
     More Monsters: The number and variety of monster encounters has been increased.
     More Exploration: Two of the levels have been expanded, with added details. Making them less linear, and more complex.
     Narrative: I've started including a narrative into the game. This will be expanded upon in due course.


This gets the game close to where I hope it to be going forward, and there are still myriad changes and improvements being worked on. Thank you for playing!

Yours Truly,

Battle Stag

notes.title: Difficult Difficult, Lemon Difficult
notes.content:
​Hello everyone,

I've been working on introducing some difficulty settings, both to make the game more accessible to those who just want to chill and explore, but also like a bit more of a challenge. The settings are:

   
  r e l a x - double the number of checkpoints, giving the game a more forgiving experience and allowing you to explore.
  s t r e s s - the original design of three checkpoints for a bit more of a challenge.
  p a n i c - no additional checkpoints, you have to complete each level without any help.


The main menu should reflect this, telling whether you've completed each level on either difficulty, as well as recording your best time for that level, if you are so interested.

A number of small fixes in addition include

    
 a restart button for each level, in case you want that perfect level time
 an out of whack reflection probe in "lights"
 a water/fail collider poking through the waterfall room in "water"
 fixed the player height in "welcome" so that crouch doesn't keep triggering
 altered the speed you have to achieve before being able to slide, stopping slide-spamming
 you may notice a few extra visual tweaks here and there


Thanks to all for your support and feedback.

Yours Truly,

Battle Stag​

notes.title: Patch 16/02/24: Optimisation Station
notes.content:
​Hello everyone,

This week I've been focusing primarily on performance optimisation. This has included batching, baking, occlusion culling and reflection probe optimisation. The FPS have greatly improved, which should hopefully translate onto your machines. 

Next stop, I'm going to be working on introducing some different difficulty settings and saving best runtimes onto the main menu.

Yours Truly,

Battle Stag

notes.title: Patch 11/02/24
notes.content:
​Hello everyone!

Today's list of changes and bug fixes include:

    
 Screen size was set to match height rather than width, to allow play with widescreens.
 Camera flickering when jumping/landing (finally) fixed. Code issue.
 Lowered the brightness of the success flashes and maxim screens, to avoid getting flashbanged.
 The first monster scare in level 2 could be re-triggered. This has been fixed to trigger once.
 Some general tidying in level 1 "water". 

Meanwhile, work continues on new content! :)

Yours Truly,

Battle Stag
